recommendation: Keep this source fix. It completes the missing canonical-datatype documentation required by the published issue while preserving the work group's decision not to use FHIR-32897 to reintroduce or broaden the old instantiates element.
issue_request: FHIR-32897 asked for the workflow instantiates relationship to support Reference when only display text is available. The final Published / Not Persuasive with Modification decision was to use the display extension instead, document that canonical can carry display without a primitive value, and defer any identifier-based protocol reference to a future extension if a use case appears.
initial_application: The Jira comment points to Git master 2ee637a94c. That commit removed the old Request/Event instantiatesCanonical and instantiatesUri pattern elements, split the workflow relationship into more specific extensions, and added workflow-extension guidance mentioning the display extension. The canonical primitive datatype row in source/datatypes/primitives.xml still only linked to canonical-reference guidance and did not state the display-extension/no-value rule.
additional_context: FHIR-29261 and FHIR-29665 were applied in the same workflow-extension commit and explain why the old instantiates shape was replaced instead of broadened. Current Extension Pack evidence shows the display extension is scoped to canonical and the replacement workflow extensions carry Reference and uri options where the later workflow model supports them. Confluence minutes for 2021-06-21 record FHIR-32897 as Not Persuasive with Modification, and a quoted Zulip search found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/datatypes/primitives.xml so the canonical primitive datatype comments mention http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/display and explicitly allow conveying a human-readable canonical target name when the element has extensions but no value.
source_changes: source/datatypes/primitives.xml: added canonical primitive datatype guidance for the display extension and the extension-only/no value case.
